== Notes ==
* The damage redirected to the user is calculated ''after'' the pet's armor, but ''before'' other [[damage reduction]] (by skills like [[Call of Protection]]). If you use this skill and you're taking too much damage, consider +[[armor rating]] skills for your pet rather than +damage reduction.
* If [[Balthazar's Spirit]] is also on the user, the energy gain triggers each time the pet takes damage.
* Being a shout, you can't end it if you're taking too much damage.
* The damage dealt to the user is typeless.
{{bug|Upon reconnecting from a disconnect when having this skill active it will appear as a [[Enchantment_spell#Maintained_enchantments|maintained enchantment]].  (See the [[Talk:Symbiotic_Bond|discussion page]] for more information and screenshots.)}}

== Trivia ==
* This is the only skill with a recharge of 55 seconds.
